description:
Tree No | Species | Recommended work


T001 | Lime (Tilia sp.) | Crown reduction roadside back to previous pollard points. Tree height 8 m with approx. 4 m crown spread.
Justification: Maintain clearance for public highway.

T007 | Lime (Tilia sp.) | Crown reduction away from neighbouring building back to previous pollard points. Tree height 14 m with approx. 4 m crown spread.
Justification: Maintain clearance from neighbouring building.

T010 | Sycamore (Acer pseudoplatanus) | Crown reduction back to previous pollard points to reduce wind loading on dysfunctional primary stem. Tree height 11 m with approx. 3 m crown spread.
Justification: modest reduction to reduce wind loading on cavity - historic tree management looks to of previously considered this.    

T013 | Willow (Salix sp.) | Pollard to form smaller wind-resilient crown or consider removal. Tree height 4 m with approx. 3 m crown spread.
Justification: primary stem compressed against boundary wall, reduction work has considered species resilience and future retention. 

T017 | Lime (Tilia sp.) | Clear lateral branches from building and street light by 3 m. Tree height 12 m with approx. 3 m crown spread. 
Justification: Maintain clearance from street furniture.
